name: How can I tell whether a cabinet refinishing company will do careful work before I hire them?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell whether a cabinet refinishing company will do careful work before I hire them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask for proof of relevant cabinet work, not just general remodeling photos. Context: Cabinet refinishing quality is difficult to judge from wide room photos because preparation, edge coverage, sheen consistency, door backs, and reassembly details may be hidden. A useful portfolio includes close-ups and projects with similar materials and color changes. Key factors: - Look for door edges, corners, profiles, frames, and interiors. - Ask whether the examples used wood, laminate, thermofoil, or previously painted cabinets. - Check whether the work was completed by the same team proposed for your project. Practical guidance: Request references for comparable scope and ask those homeowners about adhesion, schedule, cleanup, and follow-up. Confirm how samples and color approval work before production begins. Elite Remodeling & Design’s broader remodeling portfolio can be discussed alongside the specific cabinet finish approach proposed for your kitchen.
acceptedAnswer.description: Review close-up examples showing edges, profiles, frames, and reinstalled hardware, and ask whether the materials and color changes match your project. Request comparable references and ask about preparation, cleanup, curing, and post-project adjustments.
